promotedSwitches.gain: +5.13 t/s decode (+7.6%: 67.87 -> 73.00 t/s); +238 GPU expert slots
promotedSwitches.detail: Quantizes hyper-connection up/down weights to Q8_0, freeing 0.39 GiB VRAM for 2,949 GPU expert slots (72.4% hit rate). KL 0.0003-0.0010, passes 4k needle.
Caps prefill cache loan to 40% (812 slots), eliminating 128k KV growth OOM and CUDA graph verify failures with zero short-context decode loss.
Cherry-pick 20c19b89: admits PCIe-streamed expert misses directly into the GPU expert cache.
Arms concurrent CPU expert prefill for chunks <= 3,072 tokens with zero decode or pp8k regression (~0.011 nats KL).

Native Q2_0 MTP draft head over 106,299-token runtime vocabulary.

rejectedSwitches.reason: Failed Agent Quality Gate: re-biasing routing toward cached experts drops agent task completion from 5.6 to 4.5 / 10.
Failed Identity Gate (7/7 intra-boot diffs): alters tail expert selection and breaks strict JSON stop lengths.
Disabled by default in strata-lean: dropping rank >= 7 expert misses introduces KL 0.003-0.006 output drift.
Severe decode regression on Ada sm_89 from fused HC up-projection + gr_mix_r kernel.
Captures 8 CUDA graph windows instead of 6, shrinking expert VRAM and slowing verify passes.
Over-speculation penalty: 5th draft candidate falls below break-even acceptance on code.
Recruits Alder Lake E-cores 12-15 into worker pool (9 workers vs 5 P-core workers), adding barrier stalls.
Turing/Volta sm_70/75 kernels that regress occupancy and fusion efficiency on Ada sm_89.
Page-cache trap: mmapping 30-54 GB PLE evicts the 39.4 GB expert arena from RAM, causing heavy SSD refaults.
Uncapped prefetch overflows Ada's 36 MiB L2 (-3.7 t/s); 8 MiB cap is neutral. Reverted from strata-lean.
On-the-fly Q4 dequant ALU cost and reduced 40k English vocab both trail the native 106k Q8_0 draft head.
Widening to 4096-token batches evicted 1,994 MiB of experts per long prompt, triggering 4.6 GiB RAM churn and VMM remap stalls.
Even with a 16K ring cap, DSpark evicts 154-272 resident GPU experts. Keeping hot experts in VRAM + zero-VRAM --lookup 3 wins decisively.
Regressed both long prefill and post-prefill decode on 12 GB RTX 4070; pinned explicitly to 0.
Slower post-20K decode and slightly slower pp20k in the 7-arm isolation sweep.
Running 100% of misses on CPU eliminates GPU PCIe overlap and stalls expert admission.
